lines.l: Knew that something was different
So I looked
There she was
Embracing my skin in hands as though they weren't
I've always looked at my skills and wondered how much of my skin was shedding
Now I looked at her and
Wondered how much of her had shed to reveal such soft hands
Soft hands touched me once and I just knew mine were it as soft
Or I would have remembered
I remember shedding once green beliefs that no longer hold my truth
I remember shedding scars that no longer itched for attention
I remember shedding energy at Morgan House or K2
I remember tending to my soft heart by shedding negativity
And I remember python skin among whatever else our dog would have gone
If I ever had hands as soft heart I would have remembered
I don't think I could ever share enough to have them in my life better.
But I'll always remember her best friend.
I felt how her hands were so soft she must be royalty.
I'll always remember her mother.
I wondered how her palms could be so soft
after so much insistent housework.
And I'll always remember the stranger who shook my hands
With hands so soft I didn't need a need to remember
Have you ever been touched by soft hands?
Have you ever been touched by soft hands?
I once looked at my skills and wondered how much of my skin was shedding
Now I looked at her and wondered how much of her hands shed to reveal such soft hands
Soft hands touched me once and I just didn't know you learned to suffer
But I wouldn't remember
I remember shedding one's green leaves
But no longer hold my truth

My soft hands
